name: Jiangsu Lopal Tech Group Co., Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Lopal Tech Group Co., Ltd., founded in 2003 and based in Nanjing, develops, makes and sells lithium iron phosphate cathode materials and environmentally friendly fine chemicals for vehicles, under the Longpan brand in China and abroad. Related products include automotive lubricants, coolants, brake fluids, battery materials, hydrogen energy items and new plastics. It took its present name in August 2025.
